implemented_security_locks: 1. PAYMENT APPROVAL METADATA: Enforced mandatory approverId, approverRole, approvedAt, and approvalComment metadata validation and storage on cleared/approved payments.
2. MONEY RECEIPT DUAL APPROVAL: Enforced dual-approval verification (Level 1: Accounts Manager + Level 2: Managing Director) for money receipts exceeding BDT 500,000.
3. EXPENSE SELF-APPROVAL PREVENTION: Enforced strict requisitioner != approver validation blocking expense self-approvals with security violation audit logs.
4. DIVIDEND APPROVAL SECURITY: Enforced mandatory Board Resolution document ID verification and VERIFIED document status check prior to setting approvedByBoard = true.
5. USER CREATION APPROVAL WORKFLOW: Restricted executive user creation to PENDING_APPROVAL status requiring explicit Founder/Admin activation.

remaining_findings.Root Cause: BOQ rate revisions do not record digital signature hashes of approving Chief Engineer.
remaining_findings.Recommended Fix: Append digital approval hash and revision timestamp on BOQ rate changes.

remaining_findings.Root Cause: Phase 4 land purchase agreements do not mandate linked Legal Vetting Clearance Certificate reference prior to payment release.
remaining_findings.Recommended Fix: Block land acquisition payment approval until Legal Clearance certificate is uploaded and verified.

remaining_findings.Root Cause: Payroll execution logs lack dual-signature verification (HR Manager + CFO sign-off).
remaining_findings.Recommended Fix: Require HR Manager and CFO dual signature verification before bank disbursement.
